description:
Remove the per-command checks of `count` against collection length from the `cli_query_graph` suite.

## Background

The list-envelope `count` property is owned by one schema-driven test that covers each list-emitting command. Per-command re-assertions remain at `cli_query_graph/search_tests.rs:236`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test in these files asserts that a `count` field equals a collection's length.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each edited test keeps the other properties it asserted.
title: cli_query_graph tests stop re-asserting the list-envelope count
